www.elections.il.gov.en: the Illinois State Board of Elections
www.elections.il.gov.es: la Junta Electoral del Estado de Illinois (Illinois State Board of Elections)

champaigncountyclerk.com.es: la secretaría del condado de Champaign (County Clerk)

www.lakecountyil.gov.es: la secretaría del condado de Lake (Lake County Clerk)

chicagoelections.gov.en: the Chicago Board of Election Commissioners
chicagoelections.gov.es: la Junta de Comisionados Electorales de Chicago (Chicago Board of Election Commissioners)

reg_deadline.en: Regular registration closed October 6, and online registration closed October 18. You can still register and vote at the same visit, in person at a grace period site, through Election Day.
reg_deadline.es: El registro regular cerró el 6 de octubre y el registro en línea cerró el 18 de octubre. Todavía puedes registrarte y votar en la misma visita, en persona en un lugar del periodo de gracia (grace period), hasta el Día de las Elecciones.
reg_deadline.quote: Grace period registration and voting will be available after this date. Online voter registration through the State Board of Elections website will continue through Sunday, October 18, 2026.

mail_request.en: Online or by mail: your election authority must receive your application by Thursday, October 29, 2026. In person at your election authority's office: by Monday, November 2.
mail_request.es: En línea o por correo: tu autoridad electoral local (election authority) debe recibir tu solicitud a más tardar el jueves 29 de octubre de 2026. En persona en la oficina de tu autoridad electoral: a más tardar el lunes 2 de noviembre.
mail_request.quote: Last day to request October 29, 2026 (any way other than in person)
mail_request.en_after: Online and mail applications closed October 29. You can still apply in person at your election authority's office through Monday, November 2.
mail_request.es_after: Las solicitudes en línea y por correo cerraron el 29 de octubre. Todavía puedes solicitarla en persona en la oficina de tu autoridad electoral hasta el lunes 2 de noviembre.

mail_return.en: Mail: postmarked by November 3 and received by Tuesday, November 17, 2026. Drop box or your election authority's office: by 7 p.m. on Tuesday, November 3. Not every election authority has drop boxes, so check yours and its hours.
mail_return.es: Por correo: con matasellos del 3 de noviembre o antes y recibida a más tardar el martes 17 de noviembre de 2026. En un buzón de entrega o en la oficina de tu autoridad electoral: a más tardar a las 7 p. m. del martes 3 de noviembre. No todas las autoridades electorales tienen buzones, así que revisa si la tuya tiene y su horario.
mail_return.quote: All ballots must be postmarked by Election Day and received by November 17, 2026
mail_return.notes: Hand delivery by 7 p.m.: 10 ILCS 5/19-8(b) counts ballots 'received by that election authority before the closing of the polls on election day' (read on ilga.gov Oct 28); the SBE mail guide says drop boxes 'are available until 7pm on Election Day'. Watson v. RNC (U.S. Supreme Court, June 29, 2026) left post-Election Day receipt deadlines like Illinois's in place.

early_hours.en: Through Monday, November 2, permanent early voting sites are open weekdays from 8:30 or 9 a.m. to 7 p.m., Saturday 9 a.m. to noon, and Sunday 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. Some sites keep longer hours, and temporary sites set their own. Check your election authority's list before you go.
early_hours.es: Hasta el lunes 2 de noviembre, los centros permanentes de votación anticipada abren entre semana de 8:30 o 9 a. m. a 7 p. m., el sábado de 9 a. m. a mediodía y el domingo de 10 a. m. a 4 p. m. Algunos centros tienen un horario más largo, y los centros temporales fijan el suyo. Revisa la lista de tu autoridad electoral antes de ir.
early_hours.quote: beginning 8 days before election day, a permanent polling place for early voting must remain open during the hours of 8:30 a.m. to 7:00 p.m., or 9:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m., and 9:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. on Saturdays and holidays, and 10:00 a.m. to 4 p.m. on Sundays; except that, in addition to the hours required by this subsection, a permanent polling place designated by an election authority under subsections (c), (d), and (e) of Section 19A-10 must remain open for a total of at least 8 hours on any holiday during the early voting period and a total of at least 14 hours on the final weekend
early_hours.en_after: Early voting ended Monday, November 2. On Election Day, vote at your polling place or an Election Day vote center, 6 a.m. to 7 p.m.
early_hours.es_after: La votación anticipada terminó el lunes 2 de noviembre. El Día de las Elecciones, vota en tu lugar de votación o en un centro de votación del Día de las Elecciones, de 6 a. m. a 7 p. m.
early_hours.notes: 8 days before November 3 is Monday, October 26, so the 7 p.m. weekday hours apply for the rest of early voting. Read on ilga.gov Oct 28 (Source: P.A. 102-15).

cure.en: If your mail ballot is rejected, your election authority must send you a notice within two days. You can show why it should count until Tuesday, November 17, 2026.
cure.es: Si rechazan tu boleta por correo, tu autoridad electoral debe enviarte un aviso en un plazo de dos días. Tienes hasta el martes 17 de noviembre de 2026 para demostrar por qué debe contarse.
cure.quote: Such voters must be given an opportunity to appear before the election authority on or before the 14th day following the election to show cause to why the ballot should not be rejected.

in_person.en: Vote early at any early voting site your election authority sets up. On Election Day, go to your polling place between 6 a.m. and 7 p.m. Every election authority also runs at least one Election Day vote center where any voter in its area can vote.
in_person.es: Vota por anticipado en cualquier lugar de votación anticipada que abra tu autoridad electoral. El Día de las Elecciones, ve a tu lugar de votación entre las 6 a. m. y las 7 p. m. Cada autoridad electoral también tiene por lo menos un centro de votación el Día de las Elecciones donde puede votar cualquier votante de su zona.
in_person.quote: Election authorities shall establish at least one location at an office of the election authority or in the largest municipality within its jurisdiction where all voters in its jurisdiction are allowed to vote on Election Day during polling place hours, regardless of the precinct in which they are registered

first_time.en: Registering during the grace period? Bring two forms of ID, at least one with your current address, such as a driver's license, lease, utility bill or bank statement. You have to vote in person at the same visit.
first_time.es: ¿Te vas a registrar durante el periodo de gracia (grace period)? Lleva dos identificaciones, al menos una con tu dirección actual, como una licencia de conducir, un contrato de renta, un recibo de servicios o un estado de cuenta bancario. Tienes que votar en persona en la misma visita.
first_time.quote: If a voter who registers to vote or changes their address during this grace period wishes to vote in the election occurring during this grace period, they must do so in-person at the same time that they register.

locator_label.en: Polling Place Locator (Illinois State Board of Elections)
locator_label.es: Buscador de lugares de votación de la Junta Electoral del Estado de Illinois

rule.en: You can vote early at any site your election authority sets up. Your election authority is your county clerk, or a city or county board of election commissioners in places like Chicago. It posts early voting sites, dates and hours.
rule.es: Puedes votar por anticipado en cualquier centro que abra tu autoridad electoral. Tu autoridad electoral es la secretaría de tu condado (county clerk) o una junta de comisionados electorales de la ciudad o del condado (board of election commissioners), como en Chicago. Esa autoridad publica los centros, las fechas y los horarios de votación anticipada.
rule.quote: Each election authority shall determine and publish a list of the locations, dates, and hours of each early voting site in their jurisdiction.

accepted.notes: Most voters give their name and sign in; the existing FAQ answer covers the first-time mail registrant exception.

who.en: Any registered voter can vote by mail, no excuse needed. You can also ask to join the permanent vote by mail list and get a ballot for every election.
who.es: Cualquier votante registrado puede votar por correo, sin dar una razón. También puedes pedir que te pongan en la lista permanente de voto por correo y recibir una boleta en cada elección.
who.quote: Anyone can vote by mail in Illinois without an excuse, as long as they are registered to vote.

witness.en: Sign the certification on the ballot envelope. If someone helps you mark your ballot, their name and address go on the envelope too.
witness.es: Firma la certificación en el sobre de la boleta. Si alguien te ayuda a marcar tu boleta, su nombre y dirección también van en el sobre.
witness.quote: If the voter receives assistance in voting their ballot, the name and address of the individual providing the assistance must be placed on the ballot certification envelope.

cure.en: If your ballot is rejected because the signature is missing or doesn't match, your election authority must mail you a notice within two days of the rejection, with steps to fix it. You have until Tuesday, November 17, 14 days after the election, to fix it.
cure.es: Si rechazan tu boleta porque falta la firma o no coincide, tu autoridad electoral debe enviarte por correo un aviso dentro de los dos días siguientes al rechazo, con los pasos para corregirla. Tienes hasta el martes 17 de noviembre, 14 días después de la elección, para corregirla.
cure.quote: Voters are notified by mail of a rejected ballot within two days of rejection.

dropbox.en: Some election authorities have drop boxes, and you don't need a stamp. Use one by 7 p.m. on Election Day, and check its hours first. The State Board of Elections keeps a drop box list. You can also hand your ballot in at your election authority's office by 7 p.m.
dropbox.es: Algunas autoridades electorales tienen buzones de entrega, y no necesitas estampilla. Usa uno a más tardar a las 7 p. m. del Día de las Elecciones, y revisa antes su horario. La Junta Electoral del Estado tiene una lista de buzones. También puedes entregar tu boleta en la oficina de tu autoridad electoral a más tardar a las 7 p. m.
dropbox.quote: These are available until 7pm on Election Day
dropbox.notes: Drop box hours vary by election authority; the 7 p.m. time is the legal cutoff, not a promise every box is open until then.

gear.en: Look for cones or small flags about 100 feet from the entrance. Inside that line is a campaign-free zone: no one may campaign or ask for votes. The same zone applies at early voting sites.
gear.es: Busca conos o banderitas a unos 100 pies de la entrada. Dentro de esa línea hay una zona libre de campaña: nadie puede hacer campaña ni pedir votos. La misma zona aplica en los lugares de votación anticipada.
gear.quote: Election officers shall place 2 or more cones, small United States national flags, or some other marker a distance of 100 horizontal feet from each entrance to the room used by voters to engage in voting

phone.en: We found no Illinois law or State Board of Elections rule on phones or ballot photos. The law does make it a felony to knowingly mark your ballot so another person can see it, so keep your marked ballot out of view inside the polling place. Ask an election judge before you take any photo inside, and take your sticker photo after you leave. Nothing official addresses photos of a mail ballot.
phone.es: No encontramos ninguna ley de Illinois ni regla de la Junta Electoral del Estado sobre celulares o fotos de la boleta. La ley sí castiga como delito grave marcar a propósito tu boleta para que otra persona la vea, así que mantén tu boleta marcada fuera de la vista dentro del lugar de votación. Pregunta a un juez electoral (election judge) antes de tomar cualquier foto adentro, y tómale la foto a tu sticker cuando salgas. Nada oficial habla de fotos de una boleta por correo.
phone.quote: Except as permitted by this Code, any person who knowingly marks his ballot or casts his vote on a voting machine or voting device so that it can be observed by another person, and any person who knowingly observes another person lawfully marking a ballot or lawfully casting his vote on a voting machine or voting device, shall be guilty of a Class 4 felony.
phone.notes: Read on ilga.gov Oct 28 (Source: P.A. 78-887, unchanged). Perplexity cites NCSL calling Illinois ballot selfies 'likely permitted' under a 2017 ruling, Rogers v. Madison County Clerk; no court order or official statement was found to confirm it, so the page neither bans nor allows ballot selfies.

line.en: Polls close at 7 p.m. If you're in line then, stay in line. You can still vote.
line.es: Las casillas cierran a las 7 p. m. Si estás en la fila a esa hora, no te salgas. Todavía puedes votar.
line.quote: All persons in line at that time must be allowed to vote.

tradition.en: In Lake County, students designed the 2026 sticker. The County Clerk's contest asked K to 12 students for red, white and blue designs on the theme "Lake County Votes!" The grand prize design was to be printed as the official 2026 I Voted sticker at polling places across the county.
tradition.es: En el condado de Lake, estudiantes diseñaron el sticker de 2026. El concurso de la secretaría del condado (County Clerk) pidió a estudiantes de kínder a 12.º grado diseños en rojo, blanco y azul con el tema "Lake County Votes!" El diseño ganador del gran premio se iba a imprimir como el sticker oficial de I Voted de 2026 en los lugares de votación de todo el condado.
tradition.quote: One Grand Prize Winner will also receive a $125 gift card and have their design printed and distributed as the official 2026 "I Voted" sticker at polling places across Lake County! Theme: "Lake County Votes!" Must use: Red, White, and Blue with the hashtag #lakecountyvotes
tradition.notes: Contest flyer PDF (Lake County Clerk), read Oct 28 in Chrome with pdf.js; curl gets 403. The flyer gives the plan, not the winner. Perplexity named the winner (first name, Lake Forest Academy, Dec 2, 2025 announcement), but no winner announcement was found on lakecountyil.gov (site search for sticker winner and Lake Forest Academy returned nothing). Add the winner by first name and school once an official page is found.

early.en: In Champaign County, yes. The clerk's early voting steps end with taking an "I Voted" sticker once your ballot is cast.
early.es: En el condado de Champaign, sí. Los pasos de la secretaría del condado para votar por anticipado terminan con llevarte un sticker de "I Voted" después de emitir tu voto.
early.quote: Take an "I Voted" sticker and you're done!

provisional.en: You vote a provisional ballot if, for example, your name isn't on the precinct list, your eligibility is challenged, or you registered by mail without ID and still can't show it. You can bring more proof to your election authority by close of business on the Tuesday after the election, November 10. The election authority decides within 14 days whether it counts.
provisional.es: Votas con una boleta provisional si, por ejemplo, tu nombre no aparece en la lista del precinto, cuestionan tu derecho a votar o te registraste por correo sin identificación y todavía no puedes mostrarla. Puedes llevar más pruebas a tu autoridad electoral a más tardar al cierre del día hábil del martes después de la elección, el 10 de noviembre. La autoridad electoral decide en un plazo de 14 días si se cuenta.
provisional.quote: A provisional voter may submit additional information to the election authority no later than the close of business on the Tuesday after the election.

line.en: You can still vote. Polls close at 7 p.m., and everyone in line at that time gets to vote.
line.es: Todavía puedes votar. Los lugares de votación cierran a las 7 p. m., y todas las personas que estén en la fila a esa hora pueden votar.
line.quote: All persons in line at that time must be allowed to vote.

track.en: Illinois has no statewide tracker; your local election authority runs one. Chicago: the Voter Information Lookup at chicagoelections.gov. Suburban Cook County: "What Is My Mail Ballot Status" at cookcountyclerkil.gov. DuPage, Will and Kane counties: BallotTrax at dupage.ballottrax.net, willcountyvotes.ballottrax.net and votekane.ballottrax.net. Anywhere else, check your county clerk's website.
track.es: Illinois no tiene una herramienta estatal; la oficina electoral de tu localidad tiene la suya. Chicago: Voter Information Lookup en chicagoelections.gov. Los suburbios del condado de Cook: "What Is My Mail Ballot Status" en cookcountyclerkil.gov. Los condados de DuPage, Will y Kane: BallotTrax en dupage.ballottrax.net, willcountyvotes.ballottrax.net y votekane.ballottrax.net. En otros lugares, revisa el sitio web del secretario de tu condado (county clerk).
track.quote: Voter Information Lookup ... Check the status of your Vote By Mail request & counted status
track.notes: Each read Oct 30. Chicago Board (Chrome; curl 403): quote above. Suburban Cook, cookcountyclerkil.gov/elections/your-voter-information (curl): menu item 'What Is My Mail Ballot Status'. DuPage County Clerk Vote by Mail page (curl) links 'Sign Up for Ballot Tracking' to https://dupage.ballottrax.net/voter/. Will: willcountyvotes.ballottrax.net/voter/ (Chrome) is headed 'Will County Clerk / Track Your Vote' (willcountyclerk.gov blocked curl; Perplexity quotes its 'You can track your Applications and Ballots online'). Kane: votekane.ballottrax.net/voter/ (Chrome) shows the Kane County seal and 'Track the status of your mail-in ballot, from printed to accepted' (the Clerk's own page didn't load by curl; Perplexity quotes a Clerk newsletter with the URL). Lake left out: the Voter Power page (lakecountyil.gov/351) shows a registration lookup and Vote by Mail request, no status wording we could read, and lakevoterpower.info didn't load in Chrome. No statewide tracker on elections.il.gov (pass 2).

unsigned.en: Your election authority will mail you a notice within two days of rejecting it, with steps to fix it. You have until Tuesday, November 17, 2026. Watch your mail after you send your ballot back.
unsigned.es: Tu autoridad electoral te enviará por correo un aviso dentro de los dos días siguientes al rechazo, con los pasos para corregirla. Tienes hasta el martes 17 de noviembre de 2026. Revisa tu correo después de mandar tu boleta.
unsigned.quote: Voters whose ballots were rejected must be sent a notice of such along with the reason for the rejection within two days of the rejection, but in all cases prior to the end of the 14-day period in which to count the vote by mail ballots.

late_mail.en: A postmark isn't guaranteed the day you mail it. Close to Election Day, ask at the post office counter for a hand postmark, or use a drop box or your election authority's office by 7 p.m. on November 3.
late_mail.es: No está garantizado que tu sobre reciba matasellos el mismo día que lo envías. Cerca del Día de las Elecciones, pide en el mostrador de la oficina de correos que le pongan el matasellos a mano, o usa un buzón de entrega o la oficina de tu autoridad electoral a más tardar a las 7 p. m. del 3 de noviembre.
late_mail.quote: It is suggested that voters who are mailing their ballots close to Election Day go to the post office counter and request a manual postmark.

notes: Read October 21, 2026 on elections.il.gov (2026 Election and Campaign Finance Calendar, amended July 9, 2025; 2026 Illinois Voter Guide for Voting by Mail; fact sheets on Early Voting, Grace Period Registration, Provisional Voting, Voting by Mail, Registering to Vote) and ilga.gov (10 ILCS 5/17-1, 17-29, 19A-15). The SBE web calendar and election pages load their content by script and returned almost nothing to curl; the PDFs were read instead. EARLY VOTING DATES FOR states.js (status unchecked): from the SBE 2026 Election and Campaign Finance Calendar, https://www.elections.il.gov/NewDocDisplay.aspx?%2fM0cs48zOKVZyk9eAbpEoxjoGz9b5YaGE%2bEuf7JVd2Tlx2Mybp2RbacEJVh848tnFOLoTd3G4cRsCxSj%2bcrL1MmhG9QsYgJ9OQfN8tD1KknCt4vGDLyf%2beCKsyu7xmW0lAxDBpXvp%2bNIr4wjxV9GPBgF6J94lGLth4owFgdUkow%3d : Thursday, September 24, 2026, 'First day for early voting at the office of the election authority and temporary locations designated by the election authority.'; Monday, October 19, 2026, 'First day for early voting at permanent polling places other than the office of the election authority. These permanent polling places are to be open on holidays, Saturdays, and Sundays.'; Monday, November 2, 2026, 'Last day for early voting at the office of the election authority and permanent locations designated by the election authority.' So start 2026-09-24 (election authority offices only, varies by authority), wider sites from 2026-10-19, end 2026-11-02. Dates computed by me and confirmed on an SBE page: provisional follow-up deadline Tuesday, November 10 (the calendar lists 'PROVISIONAL VOTERS - LAST DAY TO SUBMIT SUPPORTING DOCUMENTATION' under Tuesday, November 10, 2026); cure deadline November 17 (the 14-day show-cause rule is listed under Tuesday, November 17, 2026). Early hours 'in the last 8 days' paraphrases 19A-15(b) 'beginning 8 days before election day'. Not found: phone and photo rule, in-line-at-closing rule, statewide ballot tracker, sticker tradition. The definition of election authority (county clerk, municipal or county board of election commissioners) is from the SBE calendar's Definitions page.

hours.en: Polling places are open 6 a.m. to 7 p.m. local time.
hours.es: Los lugares de votación abren de 6 a. m. a 7 p. m., hora local.
hours.quote: The polls shall be opened at the hour of 6:00 a.m. and continued open until 7:00 p.m. of the same day
